item.title: Projects
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Small, self-hosted apps I’ve designed and built end to end — product, code, and the infrastructure underneath. Each one has a write-up on how it actually works. Handovha A passwordless tool for turning a physical handover into a signed, verifiable certificate — photos, both signatures, and a QR code, with no account required to check it. Magic-link identity, a signature that voids itself the moment the record it covers changes, and a public verification page that proves authenticity without exposing anyone’s ID number to a stranger.
